## Purpose and delivery surface
Bot Framework Web Chat is a customizable browser chat client for Bot Framework bots. It ships consumable npm/CDN bundles, React components/hooks, optional Fluent theme, and supporting packages—not a hosted application. Primary distribution/boot entry points are `packages/bundle/src/boot/exports/index.ts`, `packages/bundle/src/boot/iife/webchat.ts`, and `packages/bundle/src/renderWebChat.tsx`.

## Composition and package boundaries
The monorepo separates public API/state contracts from UI and full-feature integration:
- API hooks, composers, localization, middleware contracts, and UI-state providers: `packages/api/src/index.ts`, `packages/api/src/hooks/index.ts`, `packages/api/src/providers/ActivityKeyer/ActivityKeyerComposer.tsx`.
- Base React UI and transcript/send-box rendering: `packages/component/src/index.ts`, `packages/component/src/ReactWebChat.tsx`, `packages/component/src/Composer.tsx`.
- Full bundle composes component/API with Direct Line, Adaptive Cards, markdown, stylesheet, and speech features: `packages/bundle/src/FullComposer.tsx`, `packages/bundle/src/FullReactWebChat.tsx`, `packages/bundle/src/AddFullBundle.tsx`.

## Conversation state and transport flow
A host creates/provides a Direct Line-compatible connection and renders Web Chat. The core Redux store receives actions, reducers persist conversation/UI state, and redux-saga handles asynchronous connection, activity observation, posting, retries/status, typing, speech, and notifications. Key paths: `packages/core/src/createStore.ts`, `packages/core/src/createSagas.ts`, `packages/core/src/sagas/connectSaga.js`. Incoming activities are ordered, patched, grouped, and livestream-aware in `packages/core/src/reducers/activities/combineActivitiesReducer.ts` and `packages/core/src/reducers/activities/sort/upsert.ts`; React-facing APIs consume that state through `packages/api/src/hooks/useActivities.ts`.

## Rendering pipeline and extensibility
The transcript turns ordered activities into activity rows, then routes each through polymiddleware/default renderers for activities, attachments, avatars, card actions, statuses, typing, toasts, and accessibility content. Main boundaries are `packages/component/src/Transcript/ActivityTree.tsx`, `packages/component/src/Middleware/Activity/defaultActivityPolymiddleware.tsx`, and `packages/api-middleware/src/PolymiddlewareComposer.tsx`. Legacy middleware remains bridged for compatibility in `packages/api/src/legacy/LegacyActivityBridge.tsx`. Consumers can replace or decorate these rendering stages rather than fork the UI.

## Rich content, security, accessibility, and styling
The full bundle renders Bot Framework rich cards and Adaptive Cards, and processes Markdown/HTML with sanitizer and streaming support: `packages/bundle/src/adaptiveCards/AdaptiveCardsComposer.tsx`, `packages/bundle/src/markdown/renderMarkdown.ts`, `packages/bundle/src/markdown/middleware/createSanitizeMiddleware.ts`. Accessibility is structural: transcript focus/navigation and screen-reader live-region output are separate rendering paths at `packages/component/src/Transcript/TranscriptFocus/TranscriptFocusArea.tsx` and `packages/component/src/LiveRegion/LiveRegionActivity.tsx`. Styling is generated from style options/style sets; Fluent is an optional theme-pack overlay in `packages/fluent-theme/src/private/FluentThemeProvider.tsx`.

## Browser services and external integrations
The browser runtime uses React, Redux/redux-saga, Direct Line/Direct Line App Service Extension, Adaptive Cards, and DOM/Web APIs. Speech can use browser Web Speech or Azure Cognitive Services/Direct Line Speech via `packages/bundle/src/createBrowserWebSpeechPonyfillFactory.ts`, `packages/bundle/src/createCognitiveServicesSpeechServicesPonyfillFactory.ts`, and `packages/directlinespeech/src/DirectLineSpeech.js`. Token generation, bot hosting, Azure Storage, OAuth/Entra ID, GitHub, and Microsoft Graph code under `samples/` are reference applications, not production library runtime.

## Validation and development surfaces
`packages/playground/src/index.js` is the interactive development host. Browser integration/accessibility regression coverage is driven by HTML scenarios under `__tests__/html2` and a WebDriver-capable harness in `packages/test/harness/src/host/jest/runHTML.js`; unit-level package tests complement it. CI/release automation is GitHub Actions-based, including ` .github/workflows/pull-request-validation.yml` and `.github/workflows/daily-release.yaml`.
